# Disk

Get the disk usage of target hosts.

## Where it is served

| Surface | Where |
| ------- | ----- |
| API | `/api/node/{hostname}/disk`, in [API](/category/api) |
| CLI | `osapi client node disk` |
| Jobs | `behavior.disk.<method>`, run by the agent |

## Built on

| Uses | Used by |
| ---- | ------- |
| Nothing | Nothing |

## Where it runs

On `linux`, `darwin`. On any other platform its methods report `skipped`.

It runs `df`, `lsblk`, `zfs`, `mount`, which the host must have installed. `osapi agent start`
warns about any that are missing.

In a trace, a call is the span `behavior.disk.<method>`, with `exec df`, `exec lsblk`, `exec zfs`, `exec mount` under it.

## Methods

| Method | Verb | Permission | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ---------- | ----------- |
| [`get`](../../usage/cli/client/node/disk/get.md) | read | `disk:read` | Get the disk usage of the host |

## Settings

None. A behavior declares settings with `behavior.Config`.

## Inspecting it

```bash
osapi behavior get --name disk                           # surfaces, methods, types, settings, telemetry
osapi behavior method get --name disk --method <method>  # one method, with its JSON Schema
```
